Whether you’re a longtime fairy lamp collector or simply looking for that one special piece to make your space feel a little more magical, we’re always adding treasures with a story to tell. 💙🌟

This Indiana Glass Co Colonial Blue “Stars and Bars” fairy lamp was distributed primarily in the 1970s. Standing roughly 6.5-7 inches tall, this pressed glass features a geometric starburst and ribbed panel design and was widely distributed through decor lines like HOMCO.

A Little Cottage Charm 🏡✨

Step into a tiny vintage village with Avon’s Cottage Collection Spice House Set, released in 1997. 🥖🌿🏡

With its colorful little cottages (including the Bakery, Market, Florist, and more) this whimsical set turns everyday kitchen storage into a miniature storybook scene.

Nearly three decades later, these charming pieces still have that unmistakable 1990s Avon nostalgia… the kind of collection that makes you stop and look at every tiny detail. 💚
